item.title: Air Force One Set to Be Repainted in Trump’s Red, White, and Dark Blue Scheme
item.description: Air Force One is being repainted in President Trump’s preferred red, white, and dark blue scheme, replacing the iconic light blue-and-white design from the Kennedy era, the Air Force says. A gold stripe will also be added, introducing a fourth color to the new design.

item.title: Trump Chief of Staff Susie Wiles Holds Meeting on Midterm Election Planning
item.description: President Trump’s chief of staff, Susie Wiles, convened a meeting Tuesday night with senior administration officials and Cabinet members to discuss the upcoming midterm election.

item.title: NATO Deploys High-Readiness Force in Europe for Steadfast Dart Exercise
item.description: More than a dozen nations have mobilized thousands of troops, backed by warships and aircraft, as NATO’s high-readiness spearhead force deploys in Europe for the first time, with major elements gathered in northern Germany for the Steadfast Dart exercise showcasing the alliance’s rapid response and collective defense capabilities.
